name: clip1
text: Dark storm clouds swirling over a tropical ocean, white-capped waves rolling fast toward the camera, spray and wind-blown mist, the camera flying low and fast over the waves. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip2
text: A satellite-style view of a huge swirling spiral of white clouds over a deep blue ocean, the spiral clearly rotating, thin cloud bands streaming into the center, the camera slowly pulling back. Realistic look, no text, no map lines, no labels, no logos.

name: clip3
text: Strong gusts of wind bending tall palm trees along a coast, waves crashing hard against dark rocks and throwing spray, low dark clouds racing past, the camera tracking sideways. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip4
text: A time-lapse of an autumn blue sea and sky with fast-moving white cirrus clouds streaming across, sparkling waves rolling in, the camera drifting forward over the water. Bright natural realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.

name: clip5
text: Heavy rain pouring on a coastal road, raindrops splashing in puddles, trees swaying in the wind, branches and leaves blowing across the road, the camera pushing steadily forward. Dramatic cinematic realistic look, no people, no text, no logos.
